description: This Java class provides a provider for various queue producers related to the transport component in the Thingsboard server, including initialization and access methods for different message producers.

classes.name: TbTransportQueueProducerProvider
classes.description: Provides queue producers for various transport-related message types in the Thingsboard server.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the message producers after construction.

methods.name: getTransportNotificationsMsgProducer
methods.description: Returns the producer for transport notification messages; not implemented.

methods.name: getRuleEngineMsgProducer
methods.description: Returns the producer for Rule Engine messages.

methods.name: getTbCoreMsgProducer
methods.description: Returns the producer for Core messages.

methods.name: getRuleEngineNotificationsMsgProducer
methods.description: Returns the producer for Rule Engine notification messages; not implemented.

methods.name: getTbCoreNotificationsMsgProducer
methods.description: Returns the producer for Core notification messages.

methods.name: getTbEdgeMsgProducer
methods.description: Returns the producer for Edge messages; not implemented.

methods.name: getTbEdgeNotificationsMsgProducer
methods.description: Returns the producer for Edge notification messages; not implemented.

methods.name: getTbEdgeEventsMsgProducer
methods.description: Returns the producer for Edge event notification messages; not implemented.

methods.name: getTbVersionControlMsgProducer
methods.description: Returns the producer for version control service messages; not implemented.

methods.name: getTbUsageStatsMsgProducer
methods.description: Returns the producer for usage stats service messages.

methods.name: getHousekeeperMsgProducer
methods.description: Returns the producer for housekeeper service messages.

methods.name: getCalculatedFieldsMsgProducer
methods.description: Returns the producer for calculated field messages; not implemented.

methods.name: getCalculatedFieldsNotificationsMsgProducer
methods.description: Returns the producer for calculated field notification messages; not implemented.
